<h2 id="一海豚调度dolphinscheduler_332的使用">一、海豚调度（DolphinScheduler_3.3.2）的使用</h2>
<ul>
<li>DAG --有向无环图，有顺序，但是不会形成环的图表。</li>
<li>海豚调度的API接口：<a href="http://YOURID:12345/dolphinscheduler/swagger-ui/index.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://YOURID:12345/dolphinscheduler/swagger-ui/index.html</a></li>
<li>参考
<ul>
<li><a href="https://blog.csdn.net/qq_43819048/article/details/132812990" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://blog.csdn.net/qq_43819048/article/details/132812990</a></li>
<li><a href="https://blog.csdn.net/xieyichun_/article/details/142066221" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://blog.csdn.net/xieyichun_/article/details/142066221</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>需要先自行安装DataX和SeaTunnel
<ul>
<li>DataX见：<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/kakarotto-chen/p/19262463" target="_blank">https://www.cnblogs.com/kakarotto-chen/p/19262463</a></li>
<li>SeaTunnel见：<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/kakarotto-chen/p/19281093" target="_blank">https://www.cnblogs.com/kakarotto-chen/p/19281093</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="1安全中心-worker分组管理">1、安全中心-Worker分组管理</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1848807/202512/1848807-20251208141030539-1845812200.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>创建Worker分组管理<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1848807/202512/1848807-20251208141748812-1182106839.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></li>
</ul>
<h3 id="2安全中心-环境管理">2、安全中心-环境管理</h3>
<p>在线配置 worker 运行环境，一个 worker 可以指定多个环境，每个环境等价于 dolphinscheduler_env.sh 文件.</p>
<p>默认环境为dolphinscheduler_env.sh文件.</p>
<p>在任务执行时,可以将任务分配给指定 worker 分组，根据 worker 分组选择对应的环境，最终由该组中的 worker 节点执行环境后执行该任务.</p>
<p>创建/更新 环境</p>
<p>环境配置等价于dolphinscheduler_env.sh文件内配置<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1848807/202512/1848807-20251208141139196-1332598882.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>使用环境</p>
<p>在工作流定义中创建任务节点选择 worker 分组和 worker 分组对应的环境，任务执行时 worker 会先执行环境在执行任务.<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1848807/202512/1848807-20251208141237496-1175382192.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>注意: 当无法在任务定义或工作流运行对话框中使用你想要使用的环境时，请检查您已经选择worker，并且您要使用的环境已经关联到您选择的worker中</p>
<ul>
<li>创建环境
<ul>
<li>需要关联worker分组</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1848807/202512/1848807-20251208142343539-1844881494.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>

<h2 id="二海豚调度dolphinscheduler-datax_30-的demo">二、海豚调度（DolphinScheduler）+ Datax_3.0 的DEMO</h2>
<h3 id="1创建项目环境变量">1、创建项目、环境变量</h3>

<pre><code>export JAVA_HOME=/……/jdk/jdk1.8.0_202
export PATH=/……/jdk/jdk1.8.0_202/bin:$PATH
export PYTHON_LAUNCHER=python3
export DATAX_LAUNCHER=/……/datax/bin/datax.py
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1848807/202512/1848807-20251208150322762-555514626.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="2进入项目-工作流定义">2、进入项目-工作流定义</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1848807/202512/1848807-20251208144302005-729439809.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>编辑datax的节点</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1848807/202512/1848807-20251208144403423-825081328.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>上图的后半截
<ul>
<li>写入datax的job.json</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1848807/202512/1848807-20251208144523165-616399383.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{
  "job": {
    "content": [
      {
        "reader": {
          "name": "mysqlreader",
          "parameter": {
            "column": [
              "id",
              "name",
              "decimal_f",
              "phone_number",
              "age",
              "create_time",
              "description",
              "address"
            ],
            "connection": [
              {
                "jdbcUrl": [
                  "jdbc:mysql://ip:port/cs1"
                ],
                "table": [
                  "t_8_100w"
                ]
              }
            ],
            "password": "zysoft",
            "username": "root",
            "where": ""
          }
        },
        "writer": {
          "name": "mysqlwriter",
          "parameter": {
            "column": [
              "id",
              "name",
              "decimal_f",
              "phone_number",
              "age",
              "create_time",
              "description",
              "address"
            ],
            "connection": [
              {
                "jdbcUrl": "jdbc:mysql://ip:port/cs2",
                "table": [
                  "t_8_100w_import_dolphin_dx"
                ]
              }
            ],
            "password": "zysoft",
            "preSql": [
              
            ],
            "session": [
              
            ],
            "username": "root",
            "writeMode": "insert"
          }
        }
      }
    ],
    "setting": {
      "speed": {
        "channel": "5"
      }
    }
  }
}
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>配置完毕，保存。然后上线</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1848807/202512/1848807-20251208144914788-195206951.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>

<h2 id="三海豚调度dolphinscheduler-seatunnel_2312-的demo">三、海豚调度（DolphinScheduler）+ SeaTunnel_2.3.12 的DEMO</h2>
<h3 id="1创建项目环境变量-1">1、创建项目、环境变量</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>创建项目：见一、3、</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>环境变量</p>
</li>
</ul>
<pre><code># 1. SeaTunnel安装主目录 (必须)
export SEATUNNEL_HOME=/……/seatunnel/seatunnel-2.3.12

# 2. Java环境 (必须，需与SeaTunnel版本兼容)
export JAVA_HOME=/……/jdk/jdk1.8.0_202

# 3. 将SeaTunnel的执行命令加入系统路径 (建议)
export PATH=$JAVA_HOME/bin:$SEATUNNEL_HOME/bin:$PATH

# 4. 自定义Connector目录 (可选，如需使用额外插件)
# export SEATUNNEL_CONNECTOR_HOME=$SEATUNNEL_HOME/connectors

# 5. 可根据需要调整JVM参数 (可选)
# export SEATUNNEL_JAVA_OPTS="-Xms4G -Xmx4G"
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1848807/202512/1848807-20251208152034925-490451760.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="2进入项目-工作流定义-1">2、进入项目-工作流定义</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1848807/202512/1848807-20251208150729115-420621034.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>编辑seatunnel的节点</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1848807/202512/1848807-20251208150842558-1635478972.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1848807/202512/1848807-20251208150957219-789954941.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>seatunnel的conf</li>
</ul>
<pre><code># demo9-mysql2mysql-dolphin-sea.conf
env {
  execution.parallelism = 16
  job.mode = "BATCH"
}

source {
  Jdbc {
    url = "jdbc:mysql://ip:port/cs1"
    driver = "com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver"
    user = "root"
    password = "zysoft"
	query = "select * from t_8_100w"
	
	# 并行读取配置
    # 数值型主键字段
    partition_column = "id"
    # 分片数，匹配并行度
	partition_num = 16
	# 批量提交数
	fetch_size = 5000
    # partition_lower_bound = 1     # 可选：起始ID
    # partition_upper_bound = 1000000 # 可选：结束ID
	
	# 连接参数
	# 连接超时时间300ms
	connection_check_timeout_sec = 300
    properties = {
      useUnicode = true
      characterEncoding = "utf8"
      serverTimezone = "Asia/Shanghai"
	  # 使用游标提高大结果集性能
	  useCursorFetch = "true"
	  # 每次获取行数
      defaultFetchSize = "5000"
    }
  }
}

transform {}

sink {
  jdbc {
    url = "jdbc:mysql://ip:port/cs2"
    driver = "com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver"
    user = "root"
    password = "zysoft"
    # query = "insert into test_table(name,age) values(?,?)"
	# 生成自动插入sql。如果目标库没有表，也会自动建表
	generate_sink_sql = true
	# generate_sink_sql=true。所以：database必须要
    database = cs2
    table = "t_8_100w_import_dolphin_sea"
	
	# 批量写入条数
	batch_size = 5000
	# 批次提交间隔
    batch_interval_ms = 500
	# 重试次数
    max_retries = 3
	
	# 连接参数
	# 连接超时时间300ms
	connection_check_timeout_sec = 300
    properties = {
      useUnicode = true
      characterEncoding = "utf8"
      serverTimezone = "Asia/Shanghai"
	  
	  # 关键：启用批量重写
	  rewriteBatchedStatements = "true"
	  # 启用压缩
      useCompression = "true"
	  # 禁用服务端预处理
      useServerPrepStmts = "false"
    }
  }
}
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>运行、查看日志同datax</li>
</ul>
